text.fa: فقط زیر نظر پزشک متخصص شیمی‌درمانی و در مرکز مجهز. عدد ماشین‌حساب = mg/m² برچسب × سطح بدن (Mosteller)؛ پروتکل، فاصله دوره‌ها، تنظیم بر اساس CBC و عملکرد کلیه/کبد با تیم انکولوژی.
text.en: Only under an oncologist in an equipped centre. Calculator = label mg/m² × BSA (Mosteller); protocol, cycle interval and adjustment for CBC and renal/hepatic function rest with the oncology team.

text.fa: هشدار جعبه‌ای: نفروتوکسیسیتی شدید (هیدراتاسیون کافی و پایش کلیه و الکترولیت)، نوروپاتی محیطی، تهوع و استفراغ شدید (ضدتهوع پیش و پس)، سرکوب مغز استخوان.
text.en: Boxed warning: severe nephrotoxicity (adequate hydration; monitor renal function and electrolytes), peripheral neuropathy, severe nausea/vomiting (antiemetics before and after), myelosuppression.

text.fa: سمیت شنوایی؛ سمیت چشمی؛ حساسیت؛ بدخیمی ثانویه؛ سمیت جنینی. با وسایل آلومینیومی تماس نیابد.
text.en: Ototoxicity; ocular toxicity; hypersensitivity; secondary malignancy; embryo-fetal toxicity. Avoid aluminium equipment.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Based on human data from published literature, cisplatin for injection can cause fetal harm when administered to pregnant women.

text.en: Label: breastfeeding not recommended, or choose between the drug and breastfeeding.

lactation.quote: Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions from cisplatin for injection in a breastfed child and because of the potential for tumorigenicity shown for cisplatin for injection, advise lactating women not to breastfeed during treatment with cisplatin for injection.

text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: Ototoxic effects may be more severe and detrimental in pediatric patients receiving cisplatin for injection, particularly in patients less than 5 years of age.

text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

text.en: Label has advice on pregnancy testing, contraception or fertility for females and males.
